anyOf.title: Null (no amount limit)
anyOf.description: No velocity limit on amount is applied to the transaction.

anyOf.title: Limit
anyOf.description: The maximum amount of spend velocity allowed in the period in minor units (the smallest unit of a currency, e.g. cents for USD). Transactions exceeding this limit will be declined.

anyOf.title: Null (no limit)
anyOf.description: No limit on the number of velocity impacting events is applied.

anyOf.title: Limit
anyOf.description:
The number of spend velocity impacting transactions may not exceed this limit in the period. Transactions exceeding this limit will be declined.
A spend velocity impacting transaction is a transaction that has been authorized, and optionally settled, or a force post (a transaction that settled without prior authorization).
